tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Noelle expressing anger, using only the supplied approved neutral as image reference. Preserve identity, face, skin tone, hair, eyes, costume, accessories, colors and rendering. Preserve her petite Medium Female proportions, maid's armor and roses. Show distinct expressive acting with a genuinely varied pose: firm brows, determined frown, feet apart and arms bent decisively at the sides. Keep normal pupils. Simple, readable hands near the torso; each visible hand has one anatomically correct thumb and four fingers connected to one palm and wrist. Do not force hidden digits into view. Exactly two legs and feet with an uncomplicated stance. Keep the entire silhouette including hair, headwear, accessories, hands and shoes visible, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding, without lengthening the body. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects or ground shadow.
